## Testing Mode
GREEN

## TDD Exemption
Unit Exemption Criterion 1: this task contains no conditional logic. It records the execution result of existing test files. No new behavioral code is introduced — only invocation and comment writing. A test for this task would be a change-detector.

## Story DD Coverage
This task satisfies:
- DD9: all tests are confirmed failing (RED) before any implementation story begins; the failing run result is recorded in a story note
- DD10: unit tests written and passing for all new/modified logic — this story creates test files only (no production logic), so DD10 is satisfied by absence: no new production logic was introduced that requires its own unit tests

## Implementation Steps
1. Run: bash tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh 2>&1 | tee /tmp/dispatcher-test-run.txt
2. Run: bash tests/hooks/test-enforcement-gate.sh 2>&1 | tee /tmp/enforcement-test-run.txt
3. Confirm all assertions show FAIL (not environment errors like 'file not found' or 'permission denied')
4. If any test shows an environment error (not a behavioral assertion failure), fix the test infra before proceeding
5. Post story comment: .claude/scripts/dso ticket comment ae31-ba7d-0861-4c27 "RED_CONFIRMATION: All $(grep -c FAIL /tmp/dispatcher-test-run.txt /tmp/enforcement-test-run.txt) tests confirmed RED. Dispatcher tests: <N> failing. Enforcement tests: <N> failing. Ready for implementation stories."

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Both test files execute without environment errors (only behavioral assertion failures)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh 2>&1 | grep -qv 'No such file\|permission denied' || true
- [ ] At least 6 tests from dispatcher file are failing (FAIL, not ERROR)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh 2>&1 | grep -c FAIL | grep -qE '^[6-9]|^[0-9]{2}'
- [ ] At least 8 tests from enforcement gate file are failing (FAIL, not ERROR)
  Verify: bash tests/hooks/test-enforcement-gate.sh 2>&1 | grep -c FAIL | grep -qE '^[8-9]|^[0-9]{2}'
- [ ] Story comment with RED_CONFIRMATION posted on ae31-ba7d-0861-4c27
  Verify: .claude/scripts/dso ticket show ae31-ba7d-0861-4c27 | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); [print(c['body']) for c in d.get('comments',[]) if 'RED_CONFIRMATION' in c.get('body','')]" | grep -q RED_CONFIRMATION

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
data.title: Run new RED test files, confirm all tests fail, record RED status in story note
